desc:
🍔 Welcome to Diner Chaos, the busiest diner restaurant in town! 🍔

Cook burgers, pizza and fries in this co-op cooking game! Run a neon 1950s diner solo or with up to 2 friends. Teamwork is key: every day gets busier and something always goes wrong! 🔥

👨‍🍳 HOW TO PLAY
🧾 Take orders at the tables
🍳 Cook burgers, fries, pizza, coleslaw and more in your busy kitchen
🍽️ Serve the right dish before customers lose patience
🧼 Wash dirty plates at the sink
❌ Lose 3 customers in one day and your run is over!

🗳️ Vote on an upgrade with your team after every day
🚨 Grease fires, burst pipes, power cuts and more kitchen chaos
🎩 Earn chef hats and climb the leaderboards 🏆
⭐ Rise from Dishwasher to Diner Legend
🛍️ Spend your hats on new looks and upgrades
📅 Log in daily for a 7-day reward streak
🎯 Complete challenges and collect 30 badges

Love cooking games, restaurant games, or playing with friends? Grab your crew and see how many days you can survive! 
👍 Like and ⭐ favorite!
